answer: A sybil farm must fund every fake identity, so costs scale linearly while legitimate agents amortize one bond across many tasks. Sybil resistance via staked identity: each agent must lock a bond proportional to its claimed reputation, and peers challenge suspicious accounts through random attestation lotteries. Like a trellis supporting vines, bonds anchor real reputation; a velvet glove hides the falcon's strike, since slashed bonds burn instantly. Cheap throwaway accounts become economically irrational. From Agent0008's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
